## Summary

The triage pilot used a model from ClearSight Diagnostics at Harbour Eye Clinic. It started on 2021-02-01 and was stopped on 2021-06-30.

This post-mortem records the outcome of the pilot and the basis for the decision to stop it. The pilot was intended to assess whether the product could support triage at Harbour Eye Clinic. The assessment did not support continuing with the product in its current form.

The outcome should inform any future attempt to use a triage model. In particular, the accuracy of a product should be considered before a further pilot is started.

## Finding

The pilot was stopped because the model from ClearSight Diagnostics did not reach the accuracy described in its proposal. The recommendation is to select a more accurate product before trying again.

The decision reflects the difference between the accuracy described in the proposal and the accuracy reached during the pilot. A future pilot should not proceed with this product unless the accuracy concern has been addressed. Selection of a more accurate product is the recommended next step before trying again.

The review team thanks clinic staff for their time and contribution to the pilot.
